title: Powerful Voices Open Mic @ Baoshi Food Hall + Bar
event_description: Multi-genre open mic showcase featuring live music and poetry performances. 3 minutes per performer with chance to win $100 prize. Community celebration of talented artists.
event_venue_information:
Baoshi Food Hall + Bar - Event Venue

Located at 8525 Pines Boulevard in the heart of Pembroke Pines Baoshi is a vibrant Asian food hall and bar that doubles as a cultural entertainment hub. The venue features five distinct Asian restaurants and cuisines along with a stylish cocktail bar and lounge area. Beyond food and drink Baoshi regularly hosts live music events and themed entertainment nights making it a social gathering place for the community.

Music and Events

Baoshi is known for hosting Powerful Voices Open Mic which celebrates diverse musical talents including live music and poetry. The venue also hosts themed nights like Ladies Night and Shinya themed entertainment. The intimate bar atmosphere combined with its open layout makes it ideal for both performers and audience members to enjoy live entertainment.

Venue Amenities

The venue features a full bar with craft cocktails and Japanese whiskeys complementing the diverse food offerings. The space is modern and stylish with both indoor and outdoor areas available for events.
